title: Central-adiposity modification of aminotransferase balance adds no reliable out-of-cycle detection of HbA1c-defined undiagnosed diabetes
abstract: A frozen AST/ALT-balance × waist/BMI interaction did not establish added detection of HbA1c-defined undiagnosed diabetes across NHANES cycles: target deltaAUC +0.000205, paired95%CI [-0.001119,+0.001489], with worse Brier score. Survey weighting and nonlinear-baseline checks did not support reliable improvement. Source4359/157 cases, independent target4706/159; nonlinear and glucose comparisons remain negative. This is a bounded predictive negative result, not absence of physiology or clinical utility evidence.
